headline: CMS INDUSLAW acts on Axis Finance $41 million NCD issuance
sum: Axis Finance Limited has made an issuance of rated, listed, secured, taxable, redeemable non-convertible debentures (NCDs) aggregating up to $41.75 million on a private placement basis. CMS INDUSLAW advised Axis Finance on this NCD…
detail: Axis Finance Limited has made an issuance of rated, listed, secured, taxable, redeemable non-convertible debentures (NCDs) aggregating up to $41.75 million on a private placement basis. CMS INDUSLAW advised Axis Finance on this NCD issuance. The transaction team consisted of Abir Lal Dey (Partner), Khushi Sharma (Associate) and Soham Dwibedi (Associate). The team had also advised Axis Finance on their $45 million NCD issuance last month .
